summary: A theatre follow spot on a rolling tripod stand: a long black lens barrel with a glowing front lens and bezel… joints pan, tilt, gel_0, gel_1, gel_2, gel_3, …; options gel; sockets operator.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.spotlight_followspot or place "prefab": "spotlight_followspot" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
